title: Active Inference for an Intelligent Agent in Autonomous Reconnaissance Missions
abstract: arXiv:2510.17450v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop an active inference route-planning method for the autonomous control of intelligent agents. The aim is to reconnoiter a geographical area to maintain a common operational picture. To achieve this, we construct an evidence map that reflects our current understanding of the situation, incorporating both positive and "negative" sensor observations of possible target objects collected over time, and diffusing the evidence across the map as time progresses. The generative model of active inference uses Dempster-Shafer theory and a Gaussian sensor model, which provides input to the agent. The generative process employs a Bayesian approach to update a posterior probability distribution. translated_title: 面向自主侦察任务中智能体的主动推理
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种用于智能体自主控制的主动推理路径规划方法。其目的是对地理区域进行侦察，以维持共同的作战态势图。为实现这一目标，我们构建了一个反映当前态势理解的证据地图，其中融合了随时间推移收集的关于可能目标物体的正面和“负面”传感器观测，并随着时间推移在地图上扩散证据。主动推理的生成模型使用Dempster-Shafer理论和高斯传感器模型，为智能体提供输入。生成过程则采用贝叶斯方法来更新后验概率分布。我们通过评估证据地图的信念概率分布与基于观测数据的目标物体后验概率分布之间的散度，计算区域内所有位置的变分自由能，从而实现智能体的自主路径规划。
tldr: 提出了一种基于主动推理的智能体路径规划方法，利用Dempster-Shafer理论构建证据地图并通过最小化变分自由能，实现自主侦察任务中对地理区域的智能探索。
en_tdlr: An active inference route-planning method is proposed for intelligent agents in autonomous reconnaissance missions, using Dempster-Shafer theory-based evidence maps and variational free energy minimization.
